body:
[A630] STOP
Head: `22840662207171f9148c4445c78e952fe19e4802` (branch `760-pdelay-hysteresis`, not pushed)
Reason: the `route-1x1` resource gate exits 1. WNS is +0.016 ns, under the +0.030 ns floor. Every other gate passes and every #760 acceptance item except the bench count is met. The remedy is outside this lane and needs a decision.

**Route evidence** (recipe unchanged: default directives, `--single-thread-synthesis`, Vivado 2026.1 build 6511674; fresh clean clones; exclusive lock)

| Figure | Dev `7d79ffb2` routed here | Candidate | Delta |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| LUT / FF / Slice | 49,613 / 52,353 / 15,725 | 49,450 / 52,364 / 15,601 | -163 / +11 / -124 |
| RAMB36 / RAMB18 / DSP | 74 / 25 / 14 | 74 / 25 / 14 | 0 |
| WNS / WHS ns | +0.215 / +0.036 | **+0.016** / +0.036 | -0.199 / 0 |

- Dev's route reproduces the `route-1x1` record exactly (gate exit 0). Candidate and dev route inputs differ functionally only in `hdl/milan/milan_datapath.sv`.
- Candidate route complete: 99,379/99,379 nets routed, 0 routing errors.
- Worst setup path: `u_pp/u_notify/cmdq_count_r_reg[0]` -> `u_pp/u_event_router/sel_r_reg[0]`, 30 logic levels on the 20 ns clock, wholly inside the protocol processor. No cell of the new stage is on any reported path.
- The recipe's other placement directives (same synthesis checkpoint per tree): AltSpreadLogic_high dev +0.066 / candidate +0.033; ExtraTimingOpt dev +0.205 / candidate +0.051.

So the change's placement shift tips paths that already have little margin. Dev alone drops to +0.066 under one directive.

**Decision needed**, one of:
1. Add margin to the processor path (`u_notify` -> `u_event_router`) in its own lane, then re-route this one. Recommended: the path is the processor's.
2. Ask this lane for a smaller formulation of the stage and re-route. Whether that passes is a placement outcome.
3. A policy disposition for this route under `docs/design/AREA_BUDGET.md`.

**Everything else at the head**
- Change: in `milan_datapath.sv`, the GET_AVB_INFO answer and the Table 5.22 detector both read a held copy of the measured delay (block `gptp_pdly_hysteresis`). While armed, a measurement replaces the held copy only when more than 32 ns away. Reset and a link drop disarm the stage, and the next measurement is served as measured. `GPTP_PDELAY` 0x6E4 keeps the raw value. No register-map or top-level port change. (IEEE 1722.1-2021 7.4.40.2, 7.5.2; Milan v1.2 5.3.6.1, 5.4.5.2 Table 5.22)
- Bound: widest recorded span of the DUT's own value on one steady link (B19 box 3, 369-391 ns: 22 ns), plus one 10 ns step of the measured mean (t1 and t4 sit on the 20 ns shipping PHC grid), gives 32 ns. Documented in `docs/design/GPTP_PLANE.md`.
- Simulation: `gptp` leg `[PDLY-HYST]`. Jitter inside the bound (including exactly 32 ns) sends no GET_AVB_INFO. One step of 33 ns is served at once and sends exactly one, carrying the step. Reset and link-up serve their first measurement as measured. 211/211 (dev 182/182); `gptp-lat` 211/211.
- Mutants: `make -C tb/verilator/milan_dp pdly-mutants` 14/14. All 12 planted defects caught, and every `[PDLY-HYST]` check is named by at least one.
- Sweep: `scripts/run_all_suites.sh <logs> --shard i/5`, i = 0..4, rc 0 x5, **63/63 suites, 2,187,307 checks, 0 failures, 0 timeouts**.
- Yosys `syn/yosys/run.sh` 58/58 tops; `scripts/xvlog_gate.py --check` 0 findings; `scripts/lint_rtl.py --check --self-test` PASS at the ratchet (90); `scripts/check_rtl_source_lists.py` 4/4 consumer lists plus `syn/ooc/dp_srcs.py` self-test and both `--top` lists; 41 static and documentation gates rc 0.
- Docs: GET_AVB_INFO rows in `docs/reference/MILAN_COMPLIANCE_MATRIX.md`, `docs/design/GPTP_PLANE.md`, the `GPTP_PDELAY` consumer note in `docs/reference/REGISTER_MAP.md`, `docs/testing/TESTING.md`, `tb/verilator/milan_dp/README.md`.
- Open: the bench count of unsolicited GET_AVB_INFO over 60 s on a steady link, before and after.
